Claim_Text: The UK committed to 100% clean power by 2030 by expanding offshore wind to 55 GW.
Cited_Evidence_Quote: Great Britain must more than double its onshore wind capacity to 35 GW, quadruple offshore wind to 55 GW, and expand solar capacity to achieve zero-carbon electricity by 2030.

Document_Title: UK Clean Power 2030 Action Plan & Whitepaper
Claim_Text: Public capital investment is set at £48 billion over five years for grid upgrades.
Cited_Evidence_Quote: The Secretary of State announces an allocated public capital commitment of £28 billion over five years to de-risk high-voltage transmission lines.
Annotation_Notes: Numerical Hallucination: The generated summary altered the actual £28B capital budget to £48B.

Document_Title: UK Clean Power 2030 Action Plan & Whitepaper
Claim_Text: Hydrogen blending into domestic residential pipelines is mandated to commence in Q3 2027.
Cited_Evidence_Quote: blending hydrogen into domestic residential pipelines remains under experimental safety review and will not be mandated until empirical pilot trials conclude.

Claim_Text: An array represents a contiguous block of allocated memory providing constant O(1) random access.
Cited_Evidence_Quote: An array represents a contiguous block of allocated memory that provides constant O(1) random access time complexity for index-based read and write operations.

Claim_Text: Inserting or deleting elements from the middle of an array incurs linear O(N) worst-case time complexity.
Cited_Evidence_Quote: However, inserting or deleting elements from the beginning or middle of an array requires shifting trailing elements, incurring linear O(N) worst-case time complexity.

Claim_Text: Linked lists allocate nodes dynamically across the heap using pointers.
Cited_Evidence_Quote: In contrast, singly and doubly linked lists allocate nodes dynamically across the heap using pointers, allowing efficient O(1) insertions at known node references.
Annotation_Notes: Accurate description of memory heap allocation.
